title: Izandla Eziqalekisiweyo
intro: Umi kwiindlela ezijikelezayo zaseMakkah yamandulo, apho umphefumlo onempembelelo nobutyebi wawukhe waphambuka kubizo lwenyaniso. Ibali lalo mntu lisisikhumbuzo esicacileyo sokuba amaqhina egazi awanakuwoyisa amatyathanga ekratshi. Ngubani lo ogama lakhe livakala njengomlilo olindeleyo?
clues: Ndihambe ezitalatweni zaseMakka ndinekratshi elandimfamekisayo ukuba ndingayazi inyaniso, nangona umthunywa wayengowegazi lam.
Izinto zam zazininzi, kodwa zaba sisiqalekiso endaweni yokuba yikhaka.
Incwadi yesikhokelo ithetha ngokonakala kwam, ivakalisa ukuba izandla zam kunye nomzimba wam ziya kutshabalala.
Iqabane lam lajoyina iphulo lam lobutshaba, liqokelela ameva ukuze asasazeke endleleni yalowo ubiza u-Allah.
Ngomhla womgwebo, ndiza kuphoswa emlilweni ovuthayo, kwaye iqabane lam liza kuba nentambo yesundu entanyeni.
Ndiyaziwa ngegama elithetha 'uyise welangatye' — igama elixela kwangaphambili indawo yam yokuhlala ngonaphakade.

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: Uza kungena eMlilweni ovuthayo, kwaye ubutyebi bakhe abuyi kumnceda nganto.
outcome.answer: Uza kungena eMlilweni ovuthayo, kwaye ubutyebi bakhe abuyi kumnceda nganto.

arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
verse: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained. (111:2)
